description: A chat's Access…: its own rules for who in the mesh may read it (list, attach, read its transcript and folder) and write it (send to it, answer it, stop, rename, archive, delete it), which go before its host's Agent Management rules. Title "Chat Access", the chat's title (a Bot's name) under it.
opens: session row right-click → Access… (a chat on a host that's up)

parts.name: Agent Management row
parts.shows: The capability's row as Settings → Access has it, its name over two lines, Read and Write, each with its email-To-style field. While the chat has no rule of its own for a side, that field holds one accent pill "Same as Host" (the server icon). The field's list offers Same as Host first, then Everybody, then the members.

actions.by: add or take out a pill (as Settings' fields)
actions.does: Sends access_set {session, capability: manage_read or manage_write, rule} at once: Same as Host added sends rule null, the host's rule again, in place of every pill; Everybody or a member added gives the chat its own rule for that side in place of Same as Host; taking out the last pill (Same as Host too) is Nobody. The host keeps the sides together as Settings' are.

decisions.said: Existing agent management, with individual chats able to override the policy (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: Every app that lists a host's chats with a row menu offers Access… on a chat, setting that chat's own manage rule, kept by its host and enforced there

decisions.said: Each capability showing two dropdowns is odd; who may should be read off a group-like list (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: A chat's own access rule is the same one control as the host's: Same as Host is a check above the members' checklist, not a dropdown entry

decisions.said: Access policies should be split into read and write where that applies (paraphrased)
decisions.rule: A chat's own Agent Management rules are split as the host's are: Read and Write, each Same as Host or its own

decisions.said: For now none of these look that nice. id say we just stick with something like email "to " lists where you get a nice drop-down, auto complete combined with pills-likes for added hosts and an "N more" suffix.
decisions.rule: A chat's own access rules use the same To-style fields as Settings → Access; Same as Host is a pill, offered first in the list, in place of the others

parts.name: Close
parts.shows: "Close": the dialog has nothing to save, each change is sent as it is made.
